raw_posts.name: HiringNow
raw_posts.tagline: AI job agent that finds & apply for jobs before anyone else.
raw_posts.description: HiringNow checks 247,000+ company career sites every 5 minutes, so you see new jobs before they hit the big boards. It matches each job to your profile, tailors your resume and cover letter, and applies on the employer's own site, only with your approval. Every application gets a receipt in your job tracker. Also: resume builder and mock interviews. Free plan with 10 auto-applies.

raw_posts.name: Businesses in ChatGPT
raw_posts.tagline: Help customers discover your business through ChatGPT
raw_posts.description: Discover how customers find your business in ChatGPT. Claim your business profile, manage information, explore insights, and create a Business Agent if eligible

raw_posts.name: Dex Semantics
raw_posts.tagline: Let your agent build analytics with 25% fewer errors
raw_posts.description: Dex Semantics adds declarations to your analytical models, which capture row meaning, join nature, how numbers add up, and decisional assumptions. Thanks to this, Dex scores 80% on ADE-bench with Claude Sonnet 5.5, compared to 73.3% without Dex (25% fewer tasks failed). Declarations live in your models as code, not a third-party tool. Dex then helps your agent convert declarations into your Semantic Layer of choice.

raw_posts.name: Gemini Robotics 2.5
raw_posts.tagline: Gemini Robotics 2.5: Google’s most capable robot model
raw_posts.description: Gemini Robotics 2.5 is Google DeepMind’s most capable vision-language-action model, turning what a robot sees and is told into hand and arm movements. Per DeepMind, it has a 30% to 100% higher success rate than the previous baseline, finishes tasks 20% to 30% faster, and reached 96% success in a Mercedes-Benz parts-kitting pilot with Apptronik’s Apollo 2 humanoid. Works across robot types. Rolling out to robotics partners.

raw_posts.name: Blender 5.3
raw_posts.tagline: 3D Gaussian splats, now native to Blender
raw_posts.description: Blender 5.3 adds native 3D Gaussian Splats across Geometry Nodes, Workbench, EEVEE, and Cycles, alongside DLSS 4.5 viewport denoising, optional Project setups, Compositor scene effects, Material Lighting nodes, and ripple video editing.

raw_posts.name: CaptureFlow
raw_posts.tagline: Open-source screen recorder with instant share links
raw_posts.description: Record your screen with the Chrome extension and share a link with your team or customers. Your AI agents can record too, through the MCP server: demos, how-tos and bug reports.

raw_posts.name: Kokonut UI
raw_posts.tagline: Open-source UI components for your AI agent
raw_posts.description: Kokonut UI is a free, MIT-licensed library of 100+ React components made for coding agents. Connect through MCP in Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code or Codex, ask for "a tool approval card in my chat", and your agent finds the component, installs it and edits it in your repo. Every docs page is also served as Markdown for agents. This release adds 65 components and rebuilds 34, led by AI chat parts: tool calls, tool approval, diff review, citations and more.

raw_posts.name: Uber Parking
raw_posts.tagline: Find, compare and reserve parking inside the Uber app
raw_posts.description: Uber Parking lets you find, compare and reserve parking right in the Uber app. Unlike circling the block or juggling a separate parking app, you enter a destination and time, see lots and garages on a map with upfront prices, filter by valet, self-park or amenities, and pay with Uber Wallet. Scan a QR code or drive in with plate recognition, extend from your phone if you run late. 13,000+ garages, lots and valets in 400 US and Canadian cities. Uber One members get 10% back.

raw_posts.name: Antelog
raw_posts.tagline: Stops AI coding agents from leaking or destroying your data
raw_posts.description: AI coding agents are amazing. Until one deletes your database, or leaks your secrets. Antelog stops the disasters before they happen, and shows you everything your AI did: every command, every website, every bit of data it sent. Works with Claude Code, Cursor and Codex. Free.

raw_posts.name: Replay
raw_posts.tagline: Mac meeting recorder with no bot. Pay once, no subscription
raw_posts.description: Replay records your Google Meet, Zoom and Teams calls right from your Mac, so no notetaker bot joins the call and nobody has to let one in. Your voice and theirs land on separate tracks, and the transcript, summary and action items are made on your Mac. Recordings stay local in ordinary files, and you can search every past meeting. Pay once, activate two Macs, no subscription. Needs Apple silicon and macOS 26 or later.
